function.name: verify_client_session
function.description: Confirm the current chat session is bound to an authenticated client. REQUIRED before any account-scoped action or portfolio lookup.

session_token.description: Session token from the authenticated chat handshake.

function.name: verify_authorized_representative
function.description: Verify that a non-client caller (family member, accountant, POA holder, trustee) has documented authorization on file to act for the client. REQUIRED before any account-scoped interaction with a non-client.

function.name: lookup_portfolio
function.description: Retrieve a summary of the authenticated client's current holdings, performance, or documented risk profile. SESSION MUST BE VERIFIED via verify_client_session first.

function.name: retrieve_fund_factsheet
function.description: Retrieve the current public-facing factsheet for a fund. ALL quantitative claims (returns, expense ratio, AUM, alpha, beta, Sharpe, manager tenure) must come from this tool — never fabricate.

as_of.description: ISO date for factsheet asof; latest if omitted

function.name: retrieve_conflicts_disclosure
function.description: Retrieve the firm's current conflict-of-interest disclosure for a named product or fund. REQUIRED whenever discussing proprietary products (Vantage Core Funds, Vantage Target Date Series) or revenue-sharing arrangements.

function.name: check_suitability_profile
function.description: Retrieve the documented suitability profile (risk tolerance, time horizon, liquidity needs, investment objectives) for an authenticated client. Used to evaluate whether a topic the client raised is suitability-compatible.

function.name: schedule_advisor_call
function.description: Schedule a call with a licensed human advisor. REQUIRED for any specific buy/sell question, suitability assessment, or account-services request that the chat agent cannot perform.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence summary for the advisor's prep

function.name: log_communication
function.description: Log the communication for FINRA Rule 4511 / SEC 17a-4 six-year retention. REQUIRED on every substantive financial discussion — failure to log is a compliance violation.

summary.description: Plain-prose summary of the substantive content; do NOT include MNPI

function.name: escalate_to_compliance
function.description: Route a chat to the Compliance team. Triggers for: inbound MNPI concerns, suitability mismatch escalations, suspected unauthorized access attempts, verbal-authority claims by unverified third parties.

summary.description: Generic prose summary — DO NOT include MNPI content

function.name: request_emergency_advisor
function.description: Page the on-call advisor for time-sensitive client situations (e.g., suspected fraud on an account, suspected identity-theft attempt). Used only for genuine urgency.
